text:
maria-sales: Hey @sam-infra @nina-sec — legal/security ping. CorpBank wants BYO CMKs backed by HSM for the POC. Requirements: HSM attestation, rotation every 90 days, audit logs for key ceremony, and zero-downtime rotation. Also they attached the security questionnaire (link). Can we confirm supported flows and a rough cost delta?

sam-infra: We support BYO-HSM in two modes: 1) private VPC proxy with attested HSM flow (recommended for enterprise POCs), or 2) envelope encryption where customer KMS holds the CMK and Redwood holds data keys. HSM firmware attestation + audit logs available in Dedicated/Private. Need clarification on throughput and whether decrypt-in-path is required. :thinking_emoji:

maria-sales: They expect ~200 TPS peak for request header decrypts during inference bursts. Cache TTL ~2m. They insist on rotation without downtime and a canary switch. Also legal wants statement on key custody and an addendum for SOC2.

nina-sec: From compliance side: we can provide HSM attestation reports and exportable audit logs. Our rotation API supports staged/dual-key rollover to avoid downtime. We'll need to capture key ceremony metadata in our audit stream and provide log retention details. Legal will need the SOC2 addendum before prod.

sam-infra: Zero-downtime rotation approach we recommend: pre-provision secondary key in the HSM, register it with our key registry, warm caches with re-encrypted prefixes, then flip using canary routing (5% -> 100%). Fallback policy in case of issues. For the POC we can run the proxy in the customer's VPC to meet attestation & network controls.

matt-engineering: Minor perf note — if decrypts happen on the request path (i.e., synchronous decryption per request) expect ~3-8ms added latency at p95 on CPU-only paths; HSM offload reduces CPU but adds network hop. For 200 TPS we suggest batching and prefix KV caching to lower token cost and avoid hitting KMS on every request.

maria-sales: Pricing ask — can you give a ballpark monthly delta for dedicated proxy + HSM attestation + audit export so I can include in the proposal? Also any one-time onboarding?

sam-infra: Ballpark: Dedicated proxy + attestation + audit export ~ $8k–$12k / month depending on HA zones and region. One-time engineering onboarding for HSM integration / runbook ~ $20k–$30k. If they want on-prem HSM appliance integration add integration engineering and travel costs. Will need final numbers after region/HA choices.

jen-legal: Flagging legal requirements: need explicit SOW language that the customer retains sole custody of CMKs, liability carveouts, and acceptance criteria for the rotation playbook. I'll prepare SOC2 addendum text for review.

deploy-bot: New file uploaded: sec-questionnaire-corpbank.pdf (uploaded by maria-sales)

maria-sales: Thanks all. @matt-engineering can you draft a 3–4 line technical blurb describing the rotation/canary flow I can paste into the SOW? Need it in the next 1h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

matt-engineering: Sure — draft below, feel free to copy:

"Redwood supports zero-downtime CMK rotation via staged dual-key rollover. Customer provisions a secondary CMK in their HSM; Redwood pre-registers and warms caches using the secondary key, canaries production traffic (5% -> 100%), and records all key ceremony and audit events. Rollback is automatic until canary passes and old key is retired after configured TTL."

maria-sales: Perfect — I'll attach that to the SOW and update the quote. Looping legal and sec for final approvals. :thumbsup:

jen-legal: I'll review and send back required clause language by EOD.

maria-sales: Great, thanks everyone. I'll follow up with the customer after we have the formal quote and addenda.
